_comment: ADR 0060 decision 5. Baseline = the gzip size of every <script src> of an empty Next route, measured at Stage 0. Allowance = what a public page may add. Change these only with the owner's approval.

office3d._comment: docs/plans/office-3d-proposal.md, decision 5: the 3D Office entry (every chunk its next/dynamic import loads: three's shared core + fiber + drei + the scene + the owl), loaded only when the 3D view is shown. Job AR: the people were replaced by owls (smaller than before: the figure code is gone), so this entry is measured as the sum of its chunks. Job CI: Agent OWL is now the plush owlet (plain DOM, CSS and a canvas, no three.js), so the 3D Office is the ONLY entry that loads three. Change only with the owner's approval.

routeJs._comment: Job CF: the gzip JavaScript every page route loads on a first visit (scripts/audit-route-js.mjs, from the build alone; `npm run audit:route-js`, run by CI after the build). Measured 12 Oct 2026 in a production build: the public pages 146 to 150 KB (React and the Next.js client are about 112 KB of it), the signed-in pages 172 to 197 KB. Each number is the measured size plus about 2%: a route that grows past it fails. `routes` names the pages people open most and the few that are larger than the rest; `public` and `app` are the ceilings of every other page. The 3D office is next/dynamic, loaded after the first paint, and has its own ceiling above (office3d); Agent OWL (the plush owlet, job CI) is in the page itself and its pictures are lazy files, not script. Raise a number only with a reason in the commit; the owner approves a raised ceiling.
